title: Sample Project One
challenge: The client needed a modern, responsive website to replace their outdated 90s-era design.
goal: Create a fast, accessible, and visually appealing site to drive user engagement and sales.
result: Increased user retention by 40% and doubled the conversion rate within the first month.

title: Sample Project Two
challenge: Building a scalable e-commerce platform that handles high traffic spikes.
goal: Implement a robust frontend using React and optimize the user flow from product to checkout.
result: Achieved sub-second load times and a seamless checkout experience.
